title: Microsoft Teams: delegators can lock calls and enable a delegate join tone
summary: The lock and warning tone descriptions match Microsoft's notice, and the existing delegation controls are documented. Minor corrections should clarify the licensing model, acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance, and extend the user configuration path.

claims.claim: Teams call delegation gains a delegator-controlled active-call lock.
claims.quote: Delegators can lock an ongoing call to prevent delegates from joining or resuming the call

claims.claim: A delegator authorizes a delegate to make or receive calls on their behalf.
claims.quote: In the context of call delegation, a delegator is the user authorizing a delegate to make or receive calls on their behalf.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Locking an active call prevents delegates from joining it.
claims.quote: Delegators can lock an active call to prevent delegates from: ... Joining an ongoing active call.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Locking a call prevents delegates from resuming it from hold.
claims.quote: Resuming a call that has been placed on hold.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Delegators can optionally enable a delegate participation warning tone.
claims.quote: can optionally enable warning tones that notify participants when a delegate joins or resumes a call.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: When enabled, the warning tone is heard by all call participants when a delegate joins an active call.
claims.quote: When enabled, all call participants will hear an audible notification when a delegate: ... Joins an active call.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: When enabled, the warning tone is heard by all call participants when a delegate resumes a held call.
claims.quote: When enabled, all call participants will hear an audible notification when a delegate: ... Resumes a held call.

claims.claim: The Lock call control is available from the toolbar during an active call.
claims.quote: During an active call, delegators can use the new Lock call control from the meeting toolbar

claims.claim: Delegators can lock an active call from the Calls experience.
claims.quote: Delegators can lock an active Teams call directly from the Calls experience

claims.claim: Delegates continue to see locked calls in their call history.
claims.quote: Delegates will continue to see locked calls in their call history.

claims.claim: Delegates cannot participate in a locked call until the delegator unlocks it.
claims.quote: Delegates will be unable to participate in locked calls until the delegator unlocks the call.

claims.claim: Warning Tone for Delegate Participation is a separate setting in call delegation settings.
claims.quote: A new optional Warning Tone for Delegate Participation setting will be available.Screenshot 3: New call delegation settings allow users to enable an audible notification

claims.claim: The change is available by default to users with call delegation configured.
claims.quote: This change will be available by default to users with call delegation configured.

claims.claim: Existing call delegation workflows are not removed.
claims.quote: No existing call delegation workflows are removed.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Scope
claims.claim: The cited Learn delegation guide does not describe the new lock or warning tone.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegated calling Lock call warning admin policy license tone; Warning Tone for Delegate Participation. Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-call-settings and teams-calling-policy; neither describes these controls.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Delegators choose to lock and unlock calls and enable or disable the warning tone.
claims.quote: Delegators can lock and unlock ongoing calls and can enable or disable the warning tone notification setting for delegate participation.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The controls are user-opt-in rather than automatically restricting existing delegation.
claims.quote: Delegators can lock and unlock ongoing calls and can enable or disable the warning tone notification setting for delegate participation. ... No existing call delegation workflows are removed.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and controls[2].api; summary; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No admin UI, calling policy parameter or API is documented to require the lock or tone or prevent their use.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegation lock warning tone admin Microsoft Teams; Teams delegate call lock warning tone licensing pricing API policy. Opened user-call-settings, teams-calling-policy, Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy, Set-CsUserCallingDelegate and Graph delegationSettings; no lock/tone control.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Call delegation is included with Teams Phone.
claims.quote: Call delegation and is included with Teams Phone.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope
claims.claim: The delegation guide says the delegator and delegate each need a Teams Phone licence.
claims.quote: In the example where a manager is delegating calls to an administrative assistant, the manager and administrative assistant must each have a Teams Phone license.
claims.fix: Add after the licence paragraph: 'The Teams Calling features comparison separately lists "Member of call group or call delegation" as available with a Microsoft Teams Enterprise licence alone, whereas the delegation guide says both parties need Teams Phone (https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/here-s-what-you-get-with-phone-system#teams-calling-features).' Add the comparison URL to sources.

claims.claim: The user must have an assigned Microsoft Teams Phone licence for an administrator to set their call settings.
claims.quote: To set call settings for a user, the user must have an assigned Microsoft Teams Phone license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has published no licence requirement specific to the lock and warning tone controls.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegate call lock warning tone licensing pricing API policy; Teams Phone licensing call delegation Member of call group. Opened user-call-settings, teams-phone-licensing and here-s-what-you-get-with-phone-system; no licence specific to lock/tone.

claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because licensing specific to the new controls is unpublished.
claims.quote: Call delegation and is included with Teams Phone.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Keep the notes naming Teams Phone and the narrower statement that licensing specific to the lock and warning tone controls has not been published; the standard uses the product-level licence for new options within the licensed product.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No meter is documented for the lock and warning tone controls.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegate call lock warning tone licensing pricing API policy. Opened user-call-settings, teams-phone-licensing and here-s-what-you-get-with-phone-system. Results about Copilot Credits concern Intelligent call delegation, not these human delegate controls.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Indirect cost; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The notice recommends briefing users who use delegated calling.
claims.quote: Inform users who utilize delegated calling about the new lock and notification capabilities.

claims.claim: The affected users include executives, administrative assistants, managers and support personnel using delegated calling.
claims.quote: Executives, administrative assistants, managers, and support personnel who use delegated calling.

claims.claim: The Learn delegation table supports joining active calls on Teams Desktop, Teams Web App (Edge) and Teams IP phones.
claims.quote: | Capability | Teams Desktop | Teams Mac App | Teams Web App (Edge) | Teams mobile iOS/Android App | Teams IP phone | ... | Join active calls | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |

claims.claim: The Learn delegation table does not support joining active calls on the Teams Mac App.
claims.quote: | Capability | Teams Desktop | Teams Mac App | Teams Web App (Edge) | Teams mobile iOS/Android App | Teams IP phone | ... | Join active calls | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |

claims.claim: The Learn delegation table does not support joining active calls on the Teams mobile app.
claims.quote: | Capability | Teams Desktop | Teams Mac App | Teams Web App (Edge) | Teams mobile iOS/Android App | Teams IP phone | ... | Join active calls | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |

claims.claim: Client-specific differences in the lock and warning tone behaviour are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegation warning tone default lock JoinActiveCalls PickUpHeldCalls; Teams delegated calling Lock call warning admin policy license tone. Read MC1429012 and user-call-settings: platform lists and general delegation capabilities, but no client-specific lock/tone differences.

claims.claim: AllowDelegation enables call delegation generally, rather than individually configuring the lock or tone.
claims.quote: Enables the user to configure delegation in the Microsoft Teams client and that inbound calls to be routed to delegates; allows delegates to make outbound calls on behalf of the users for whom they have delegated permissions.

claims.claim: The general AllowDelegation setting is on by default.
claims.quote: You enable delegation by using the TeamsCallingPolicy AllowDelegation setting. You can use Teams admin center or Teams PowerShell. This setting is turned on by default.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Delegation for inbound and outbound calls reaches the delegation setting.
claims.quote: select Voice > Calling policies. ... Choose the policy you would like to update ... Toggle Delegation for inbound and outbound calls on.
claims.fix: Keep this cited route, but add: 'The Calling policies guide gives an explicit Edit step after selecting an existing policy: Voice > Calling policies > policy > Edit > Delegation for inbound and outbound calls (https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/teams-calling-policy#edit-a-calling-policy).' Add that URL to sources.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowDelegation $true|$false configures delegation in an existing calling policy.
claims.quote: Use this cmdlet to update values in existing Teams Calling Policies. ... [-Identity] <string> ... [-AllowDelegation <boolean>]

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Users > Manage users > user > Voice reaches the user's delegation configuration page.
claims.quote: go to Users > Manage users and select a licensed user. ... go to the Voice tab. ... select Call delegation under Also allow. Then add the appropriate delegates by selecting Add people
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path and its rendered table path to 'Users > Manage users > user > Voice > Call answering rules > Ring the user's devices > Also allow > Call delegation > Add people', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-call-settings#use-the-teams-admin-center. The shorter inventory route in Before rollout can remain.

claims.claim: Set-CsUserCallingDelegate with Identity, Delegate and the five Boolean permission parameters changes an existing delegate's permissions.
claims.quote: Set-CsUserCallingDelegate -Identity <String> -Delegate <String> [-MakeCalls <Boolean>] [-ManageSettings <Boolean>] [-ReceiveCalls <Boolean>] [-PickUpHeldCalls <Boolean>] [-JoinActiveCalls <Boolean>]

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: JoinActiveCalls is a per-delegate permission to join active calls on behalf of the specified user.
claims.quote: Specifies whether delegate is allowed to join active calls on behalf of the specified user.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: PickUpHeldCalls is a per-delegate permission to pick up calls on behalf of the specified user.
claims.quote: Specifies whether delegate is allowed to pick up calls on behalf of the specified user.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Neither the notice nor Learn explains the interaction between the per-call lock and JoinActiveCalls or PickUpHeldCalls.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegation warning tone default lock JoinActiveCalls PickUpHeldCalls. Read MC1429012, user-call-settings, Set-CsUserCallingDelegate and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; no explanation of the lock's interaction with these permissions.

claims.claim: Get-CsUserCallingSettings -Identity <user> displays the user's delegation settings.
claims.quote: To display the current call forward and delegation settings for a user, use the Get-CsUserCallingSettings cmdlet ... Get-CsUserCallingSettings -Identity user1@contoso.com

claims.claim: Remove-CsUserCallingDelegate removes a delegate relationship.
claims.quote: Remove-CsUserCallingDelegate - removes a delegate from a user.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft requires cleanup of a user's delegation relationships in Teams admin center when delegation is turned off to avoid incorrect call routing.
claims.quote: When you turn off delegation for a user, you also need to clean up delegation relationships for that user in the Teams admin center to avoid incorrect call routing.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends assigning the same calling policy to delegates and delegators.
claims.quote: the delegate is bound to the settings configured in their calling policy ... Therefore, it's recommended that delegates and delegators are assigned the same calling policy.

claims.claim: The notice says the Share a phone line with a delegate support article will be updated for the GA rollout.
claims.quote: Learn more: Share a phone line with a delegate in Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Support (will be updated for GA rollout)

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The notice recommends reviewing how call delegation is used within the organization.
claims.quote: Review how call delegation is used within your organization.

claims.claim: The notice recommends evaluating whether to recommend the warning tone for confidential or sensitive conversations.
claims.quote: Evaluate whether the delegate participation warning tone should be recommended for users handling confidential or sensitive conversations.

claims.claim: The notice calls the warning tone optional but does not state its initial on/off default.
claims.quote: Searched: Warning Tone for Delegate Participation; lock call delegation default. Read MC1429012: optional setting, no initial tone default. Opened user-call-settings and teams-calling-policy: neither names the tone or its default.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the warning tone can be set per delegate.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegation warning tone default lock JoinActiveCalls PickUpHeldCalls; Warning Tone for Delegate Participation. Read MC1429012, user-call-settings, Set-CsUserCallingDelegate and Graph delegationSettings: no per-delegate tone setting.

claims.claim: A delegate with a different calling policy is bound to their own policy, not the delegator's permissions.
claims.quote: the delegate is bound to the settings configured in their calling policy and the permissions of the delegator's calling policy are not transferred to the delegate.
